purpose: Optional, non-mutating parentage extension to the legacy same-block visitor→SVD→dependency→seed chain. Paternity requires offspring genotypes; a stigma pollen count cannot identify a father.
unit: block_id x plant_id, with offspring nested in fruit and plant; candidate father sets belong to a defined pool
constraints: No prior outcomes may be used to define blocks or admit sites.
Only open-pollinated mature fruit offspring can contribute to the observational paternity summary, distinct from experimental treatments.
Exactly one self and one unsampled_or_unknown probability category per usable offspring, plus zero or more named fathers; sum of posterior probabilities must be one.
Selfing probability and unsampled-father probability must never be manufactured from SVD, visit observations, absent genotype records, or missing father candidates.
Every named father must have independently registered genotype evidence in the candidate father pool; candidate census completeness is not assumed.
Genotyping failed or pending offspring remain explicit; they never become selfed, zero pollen, or excluded from the sampling denominator without documentation.
No offspring, fruits, or father assignments may be used as independent island-system replicates or support genetic evolution without longitudinal evidence.
Only externally adjudicated site admission, access permissions and seasonal blocks can open field work; this auditor cannot grant permits.
